name: Generate and Deploy Nginx Configurations from a Web Form

parameters.command:
=set -e


source /etc/os-release


case "$ID" in

debian|ubuntu|linuxmint|pop)

    NGINX_CONFIG="/etc/nginx/sites-available/{{ $('Generate nginx Config').item.json.domain }}"

    sudo tee "$NGINX_CONFIG" <<'EOF'
{{ $('Generate nginx Config').item.json.nginxConfig }}
EOF


    sudo ln -sf \
    "$NGINX_CONFIG" \
    "/etc/nginx/sites-enabled/{{ $('Generate nginx Config').item.json.domain }}"


    ;;


*)

    NGINX_CONFIG="/etc/nginx/conf.d/{{ $('Generate nginx Config').item.json.domain }}.conf"


    sudo tee "$NGINX_CONFIG" <<'EOF'
{{ $('Generate nginx Config').item.json.nginxConfig }}
EOF

    ;;


esac



sudo nginx -t

sudo systemctl reload nginx



if [ "{{ $('Validate Routes').item.json.enableSSL }}" = "true" ]; then


sudo certbot \
    --nginx \
    -d {{ $('Generate nginx Config').item.json.domain }} \
    --non-interactive \
    --agree-tos \
    -m '{{ $('Validate Routes').item.json.sslEmail }}'


fi


echo "Deployment completed"

=set -e

export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive


# -------------------------------
# Detect OS
# -------------------------------

if [ ! -f /etc/os-release ]; then
    echo "Unsupported Linux distribution"
    exit 1
fi

source /etc/os-release


PKG_MANAGER=""
NGINX_USER=""
NGINX_CONF_DIR=""
SELINUX_ENABLED=false


case "$ID" in

    debian|ubuntu|linuxmint|pop)

        PKG_MANAGER="apt"
        NGINX_USER="www-data"
        NGINX_CONF_DIR="/etc/nginx/sites-available"
        
        ;;


    rhel|centos|fedora|rocky|almalinux)

        PKG_MANAGER="dnf"
        NGINX_USER="nginx"
        NGINX_CONF_DIR="/etc/nginx/conf.d"
        SELINUX_ENABLED=true

        ;;


    arch|manjaro)

        PKG_MANAGER="pacman"
        NGINX_USER="http"
        NGINX_CONF_DIR="/etc/nginx/conf.d"

        ;;


    opensuse*|sles)

        PKG_MANAGER="zypper"
        NGINX_USER="nginx"
        NGINX_CONF_DIR="/etc/nginx/conf.d"
        
        ;;


    *)

        echo "Unsupported distro: $ID"
        exit 1

        ;;

esac


echo "Detected:"
echo "OS: $ID"
echo "Package manager: $PKG_MANAGER"
echo "Nginx user: $NGINX_USER"



# -------------------------------
# Package installer
# -------------------------------

install_package()
{

    package="$1"


    case "$PKG_MANAGER" in

        apt)

            sudo apt update -y
            sudo apt install -y "$package"

            ;;


        dnf)

            sudo dnf install -y "$package"

            ;;


        pacman)

            sudo pacman -Sy --noconfirm "$package"

            ;;


        zypper)

                sudo zypper refresh

                if grep -qi tumbleweed /etc/os-release; then
                    sudo zypper dup -y
                fi

                sudo zypper --non-interactive  install --allow-vendor-change "$package"

            ;;

    esac

}



# -------------------------------
# Install ACL
# -------------------------------

if ! command -v setfacl >/dev/null 2>&1; then

    echo "Installing ACL..."

    install_package acl

fi



# -------------------------------
# Install jq
# -------------------------------

if ! command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1; then

    echo "Installing jq..."

    install_package jq

fi



# -------------------------------
# Install SELinux tools
# -------------------------------

if [ "$SELINUX_ENABLED" = true ]; then


    if ! command -v semanage >/dev/null 2>&1; then

        echo "Installing SELinux utilities..."

        install_package policycoreutils-python-utils

    fi


fi



# -------------------------------
# Install nginx
# -------------------------------

if ! command -v nginx >/dev/null 2>&1; then

    echo "Installing nginx"

    install_package nginx

fi



sudo systemctl enable nginx
sudo systemctl start nginx



# -------------------------------
# Install certbot using snap
# -------------------------------

if ! command -v certbot >/dev/null 2>&1; then

    echo "Installing certbot using snap"


    if ! command -v snap >/dev/null 2>&1; then

        echo "Installing snapd"

        if [ "$PKG_MANAGER" = "apt" ]; then

            sudo apt update -y
            sudo apt install -y snapd

        elif [ "$PKG_MANAGER" = "dnf" ]; then

            echo "Enabling EPEL repository"

            sudo dnf install -y epel-release || true

            sudo dnf install -y snapd

            sudo systemctl enable --now snapd.socket

            sudo ln -sf /var/lib/snapd/snap /snap

        elif [ "$PKG_MANAGER" = "zypper" ]; then

            echo "Installing snapd on openSUSE"

            sudo zypper addrepo --refresh \
                https://download.opensuse.org/repositories/system:/snappy/openSUSE_Tumbleweed \
                snappy

            sudo zypper --gpg-auto-import-keys refresh

            sudo zypper dup --from snappy

            sudo zypper refresh

            sudo zypper install -y snapd

            sudo systemctl enable --now snapd

            sudo ln -sf /var/lib/snapd/snap /snap

        fi


    fi


    sudo snap install core || true

    sudo snap refresh core || true


    sudo snap install --classic certbot


    sudo ln -sf /snap/bin/certbot /usr/bin/certbot


fi



# -------------------------------
# Create nginx directories
# -------------------------------

sudo mkdir -p "$NGINX_CONF_DIR"



if [ "$PKG_MANAGER" = "apt" ]; then

    sudo mkdir -p \
        /etc/nginx/sites-available \
        /etc/nginx/sites-enabled

fi



# -------------------------------
# Firewall
# -------------------------------


if command -v ufw >/dev/null 2>&1; then


    sudo ufw allow 'Nginx Full' || true



elif command -v firewall-cmd >/dev/null 2>&1; then


    sudo firewall-cmd \
        --permanent \
        --add-service=http || true


    sudo firewall-cmd \
        --permanent \
        --add-service=https || true


    sudo firewall-cmd --reload || true



elif command -v nft >/dev/null 2>&1; then


    echo "nftables detected. Firewall rules skipped."


fi





# -------------------------------
# Nginx filesystem permissions
# -------------------------------


allowNginxRootAccess='{{ $('Validate Routes').item.json.allowNginxRootAccess }}'

routes='{{ JSON.stringify($('Validate Routes').item.json.routes) }}'



if [ "$allowNginxRootAccess" = "true" ]; then


echo "Configuring nginx filesystem permissions..."



echo "$routes" | jq -r '
    .[]
    | select(.type == "static" and .filesystemPath != null)
    | .filesystemPath
' | while read -r path; do



    if [ -z "$path" ]; then
        continue
    fi



    if [ ! -d "$path" ]; then

        echo "Skipping missing path: $path"
        continue

    fi



    echo "Granting access to $NGINX_USER: $path"



    # ---------------------------
    # Linux permissions
    # ---------------------------


    current="$path"


    while [ "$current" != "/" ]; do


        sudo setfacl \
            -m u:$NGINX_USER:x \
            "$current"



        current=$(dirname "$current")


    done



    sudo setfacl \
        -R \
        -m u:$NGINX_USER:rX \
        "$path"




    # ---------------------------
    # SELinux permissions
    # ---------------------------


    if [ "$SELINUX_ENABLED" = true ]; then


        if command -v getenforce >/dev/null 2>&1; then


            if [ "$(getenforce)" != "Disabled" ]; then


                echo "Applying SELinux context: $path"



                sudo semanage fcontext \
                    -a \
                    -t httpd_sys_content_t \
                    "$path(/.*)?" \
                    || true



                sudo restorecon \
                    -Rv \
                    "$path"



            fi


        fi


    fi



done



else


echo "Filesystem permissions skipped."


fi




# -------------------------------
# SELinux nginx proxy permission
# -------------------------------


if [ "$SELINUX_ENABLED" = true ]; then


    if command -v getenforce >/dev/null 2>&1; then


        if [ "$(getenforce)" != "Disabled" ]; then


            echo "Allowing nginx network connections..."

            sudo setsebool \
                -P \
                httpd_can_network_connect \
                1


        fi


    fi


fi





echo "Restarting nginx"

sudo nginx -t

sudo systemctl restart nginx



echo "Server prepared:"
echo "$(nginx -v 2>&1)"
echo "$(certbot --version 2>&1 || true)"

parameters.content:
# 🚀 Quick Start

### 1. Configure SSH Credentials

Open the **`Prepare Machine`** node and create an **SSH Credential** using your server connection details.

Then open **`Deploy Nginx Server`** and select the same credential.

---

### 2. Configure Webhook Authentication

Open the **`Start Workflow`** node and create an **HTTP Basic Auth Credential**.

Choose a username and password. You will use these credentials to access the configuration form.

---

### 3. Configure Cloudflare Credentials — Optional

This step is only required if you want the workflow to automatically create or update the domain’s DNS record in Cloudflare.

Open the Cloudflare-related nodes in the workflow and configure their **Cloudflare Credential**.

Use a Cloudflare API token with permission to manage DNS records for the required zone.

Make sure the same Cloudflare credential is selected in all Cloudflare nodes.

If Cloudflare is not configured, leave the **Use Cloudflare for DNS** checkbox disabled in the configuration form.

---

### 4. Open the Configuration Form

From the **`Start Workflow`** node, copy the **Production URL**.

It will look similar to:

```text
https://<your-n8n-domain>/webhook/nginx
```

Open this URL in your browser and sign in using the username and password you created in the previous step.

---

### 5. Run the Workflow

Make sure the workflow is **active** in n8n before opening and using the production webhook.

For better security, keep this workflow active only while you are using the configuration form. When you have finished deploying your Nginx configuration, **deactivate the workflow** so the production webhook is no longer available.

> **Security recommendation:** Only activate this workflow when you need to configure or deploy Nginx, and deactivate it again when you are finished.

---

### 6. Deploy

Complete the configuration form.

Enable **Use Cloudflare for DNS** only if you have configured the Cloudflare nodes and credentials.

Then click **Generate & Deploy**.

🎉 Your Nginx configuration will be generated and deployed automatically.

parameters.content:
# Optional DNS Setup

Configure the Cloudflare credentials in the nodes below if you want the workflow to automatically manage the domain's DNS record.

# Webhook intake

Receives the web form submission and sends the initial webhook acknowledgement before the longer provisioning path continues.

# Validate form input

Checks the submitted route data and branches between the valid deployment path and an immediate validation error response.

# Generate deployment plan

Builds the nginx configuration from the validated input and decides whether a Cloudflare DNS record needs to be created before server deployment.

# Deploy nginx server

Prepares the remote machine, deploys the generated nginx configuration over SSH, and returns the success response when deployment completes.

## Handle provisioning failure

Collects failures from DNS creation and SSH deployment paths into a final webhook failure response.
